passages.original: Numquid eumdem novit Filium 31 Christum de Maria Virgine natum, qui Sermo caro factus sit, qui peccata nostra portaverit, qui mor- tem moriendo vicerit, qui resurrectionem carnis per semetipsum primus initiaverit, et discipulis suis quod in eadem carne resurrexisset ostenderit? Longe alia est apud Marcionem, sed et apud caete- ros haeretacos fides. Imo nihil est apud illos nissi perfidia et blasphemia et contentio sanctitatis 32 (28) et veritatis inimica. Quomodo ergo potest videri qui apud illos baptizatur conseculus esse peccatorum remissam, et divinae indulgentiae gratiam per suam fidem, qui ipsius fidei non habuerit veritatem?
passages.english: Does he know the same Son, Christ, born of the Virgin Mary, who as the Word was made flesh, who bore our sins, who conquered death by dying, who first by himself began the resurrection of the flesh, and showed his disciples that he had risen in that same flesh? Far different is the faith among Marcion, and among the rest of the heretics too. Indeed, there is nothing among them but faithlessness and blasphemy and contentiousness, hostile to holiness and truth. How then can one who is baptized among them be seen to have obtained the remission of sins and the grace of divine pardon through his faith, when he has not had the truth of that faith itself?
passages.notes: Scanning errors corrected silently: 'haeretacos' for haereticos, 'nissi' for nisi, 'conseculus' for consecutus, 'remissam' for remissam/remissionem. Numbers 31, 32 and (28) are footnote and note marks and are omitted.
